## Design

### 2026-10-05 – ![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/X0M6LJbzvf8ujgpaHbOxZvjUJlhiqsPd/e1457f68662dffb22d88cd3f1e229a2e67d8ac9a2db624b8b2bc84cde25e5d1e.png)

**0.5h**

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/X0M6LJbzvf8ujgpaHbOxZvjUJlhiqsPd/e1457f68662dffb22d88cd3f1e229a2e67d8ac9a2db624b8b2bc84cde25e5d1e.png)

I looked into different designs made by other people and watched some videos to get more information about the competition. I am thinking of using two motors to drive the board with a trailing wheel. To navigate the track, I want to use some distance sensor (IR or ToF) to accurately read the track. On top of that, I also want to add an encoder to track the rotation of the wheel so there can be feedback to move to a desired position.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/X0M6LJbzvf8ujgpaHbOxZvjUJlhiqsPd/ebe24b73b3077c432c194c2d7f02bc39f686b805c697078c276886e5029f0b76.png)

### 2026-10-07 – I worked on researching different components I need for this project and determined the inputs and outputs I want the microcontroller to manage.

**2h**

I worked on researching different components I need for this project and determined the inputs and outputs I want the microcontroller to manage.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/X0M6LJbzvf8ujgpaHbOxZvjUJlhiqsPd/4dd66f9624b700294083f874a99051e564d24e6111190926860f758ed0a70072.png)

I started bringing together the things I have from old projects. I have a few things that I can recycle from them for this project. I have a few Time of Flight sensors and I am also planning to use Teensy 4.0 microcontroller for this project! I worked on bringing in a few connectors into the schematic for the sensors. I currently am thinking of using 3, but I want the board to support up to 5 of them. I also looked into some motor driver designs and I am thinking of designing my own H-bridge circuit instead of using a separate component. (I currently have DRV8835 driver but I want to integrate my own into the PCB. I am currently looking more into the designs and choosing components.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/X0M6LJbzvf8ujgpaHbOxZvjUJlhiqsPd/379c344eb5c7a4618137bee1e24fb3b32435e4a55825760dc32ea0dc3caf6626.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/X0M6LJbzvf8ujgpaHbOxZvjUJlhiqsPd/1de269da0f927ed1caa7cf4c1c3bac4c7508c78794bf6d277ddb9dda74e7b54c.png)

### 2026-10-07 – Looked into motor drivers and found one that fits a simple DC brushless motor. This is the schematic that I came up with:

**2h**

Looked into motor drivers and found one that fits a simple DC brushless motor. This is the schematic that I came up with:
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/X0M6LJbzvf8ujgpaHbOxZvjUJlhiqsPd/29f09a5d866812166f61559341b2b2c14b841a50112b5725f6f05eddd9c123e0.png)

I looked into regulating power and watched some videos on this. I implemented a buck converter to reduce the voltage from the battery down to 5 volts to power the microcontroller.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/X0M6LJbzvf8ujgpaHbOxZvjUJlhiqsPd/8c5b26be5351bd9cca93cff39411eb8ce4a37afd72d3086b6eab44655efb3218.png)
